methods.name: is_min_max_backwards_compatible
methods.summary: Old versions of parquet stored statistics in `min` and `max` fields, ordered using signed comparison. This resulted in an undefined ordering for unsigned quantities, such as booleans and unsigned integers.

methods.name: is_min_max_deprecated
methods.summary: Returns `true` if statistics have old `min` and `max` fields set. This means that the column order is likely to be undefined, which, for old files could mean a signed sort order of values.

methods.name: max_bytes_opt
methods.summary: Returns slice of bytes that represent max value, if max value is known.

methods.name: max_is_exact
methods.summary: Returns `true` if the max value is set, and is an exact max value.

methods.name: min_bytes_opt
methods.summary: Returns slice of bytes that represent min value, if min value is known.

methods.name: min_is_exact
methods.summary: Returns `true` if the min value is set, and is an exact min value.

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new<T: ParquetValueType>(min: Option<T>, max: Option<T>, distinct_count: Option<u64>, null_count: Option<u64>, is_deprecated: bool) -> Self
methods.summary: Creates new statistics for a column type

methods.name: null_count_opt
methods.summary: Returns number of null values for the column, if known. Note that this includes all nulls when column is part of the complex type.

methods.name: physical_type
methods.summary: Returns physical type associated with statistics.

items.name: ValueStatistics
items.summary: Typed statistics for one column chunk

methods.name: distinct_count
methods.summary: Returns optional value of number of distinct values occurring.

methods.name: is_min_max_backwards_compatible
methods.summary: Old versions of parquet stored statistics in `min` and `max` fields, ordered using signed comparison. This resulted in an undefined ordering for unsigned quantities, such as booleans and unsigned integers.

methods.name: max_bytes_opt
methods.summary: Returns max value as bytes of the statistics, if max value is known.

methods.name: max_is_exact
methods.summary: Whether or not max value is set, and is an exact value.

methods.name: max_opt
methods.summary: Returns max value of the statistics, if known.

methods.name: min_bytes_opt
methods.summary: Returns min value as bytes of the statistics, if min value is known.

methods.name: min_is_exact
methods.summary: Whether or not min value is set, and is an exact value.

methods.name: min_opt
methods.summary: Returns min value of the statistics, if known.

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new(min: Option<T>, max: Option<T>, distinct_count: Option<u64>, null_count: Option<u64>, is_min_max_deprecated: bool) -> Self
methods.summary: Creates new typed statistics.

methods.name: null_count_opt
methods.summary: Returns null count.

methods.name: with_backwards_compatible_min_max
methods.summary: Set whether to write the deprecated `min` and `max` fields for compatibility with older parquet writers

methods.name: with_max_is_exact
methods.summary: Set whether the stored `max` field represents the exact maximum, or just a bound on the maximum value.

methods.name: with_min_is_exact
methods.summary: Set whether the stored `min` field represents the exact minimum, or just a bound on the minimum value.
